chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from al-Fadl al-Khazzaz al-Mada'ini, the mawla of Khadijah daughter of Muhammad Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, said:
A group from the people of al-Madinah, from the Talibiyyin, used to hold to the truth, and the stipends used to come to them at a known time.
Then when Abu Muhammad عليه السلام passed away, a group among them turned back from the belief in the son.
So the stipends came to those among them who remained firm upon the belief in the son, and they were cut off from the rest.
So they are not mentioned among those who are remembered, and all praise belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds.

key_terms.الذَّاكِرِينَ: those who are remembered or mentioned
key_terms.الطَّالِبِيِّينَ: the descendants or affiliates of Abu Talib mentioned as the group in al-Madinah
key_terms.الْقَوْلِ بِالْوَلَدِ: the belief in the son, i.e. affirming the son after Abu Muhammad عليه السلام
key_terms.الْوَظَائِفُ: stipends or allotted provisions sent regularly
key_terms.بِالْحَقِّ: upon the truth; holding the correct belief

ai.seo_question: What happened to those who denied the son after the passing of Abu Muhammad عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This report describes a group from the Talibiyyin in al-Madinah who had held to the truth and received regular stipends. After the passing of Abu Muhammad عليه السلام, some abandoned belief in the son, while those who remained steadfast continued receiving support, marking a distinction between steadfast recognition and retreat from it.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad, from Al Fazl Al Khazzaz Al Madainy, 
‘A slave of Khadeeja, daughter of Muhammad Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said, ‘
There was a group from the people of Al-Medina from the Talibiyyin. They were saying (believing) in the truth, and it was so that the stipends used to arrive to them during a known time.
So when Abu Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> (11<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) passed away, a group from them retracted from the words (beliefs) with the arrival (of Al-Qaim<sup>asws</sup>).
So the stipends continued arriving upon the ones who were steadfast from them upon the word (belief), and it was cut off from the remainder,
so they are no longer among the remembered ones, and the Praise is for the Lord<sup>azwj</sup> of the worlds’.
en.sarwar: 7. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from al-Fadl al-Khazzaz al-Mada-’ini, the slave of Khadija daughter of Muhammad abu Ja‘far (a.s.)who has said the following “
Certain people of the city of al-Madina that belonged to al-Talibiyin group believed in the truth (about Ahl al-Bayt). They would receive their financial grants regularly on time.
When abu Muhammad (a.s.) passed away a few of them disregarded the belief that abu Muhammad (a.s.) has behind a son.
The financial grants thereafter would come only to those who still believed in son of abu Muhammad (a.s.) and stopped coming to the others.
They no more are mentioned along with those who are mentioned. All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds.”
